daily.title: CBI Secures Deportation of Murder Case Accused Rajesh Keshava Acharya Absconding Since 2019 from UAE to India
daily.summary: The CBI secured an Interpol Red Notice against murder case accused Rajesh Keshava Acharya, who was arrested by UAE authorities and deported to India. At Karnataka Police's request , the Central Bureau of Investigation ( CBI ) secured an international Red Notice in May 2026 against Rajesh Keshava Acharya , a wanted suspect in a murder case for abetment. On November 27, 2026 , he was deported and returned to India. The dispute arose in July 2002 , when the accused Rajesh Keshava Acharya, in conspiracy with other accused individuals, murdered Manohar Shetty .

daily.title: India markets rebound in November; domestic growth drivers key to 2027 rally: HSBC
daily.summary: HSBC sees November’s broad Indian market rebound as a shift to risk-on, driven by global cues and domestic growth, with 2027 gains hinging on stronger growth and banking liquidity. Equities, the rupee and government bonds have all rallied, signalling a shift in market sentiment from risk-off to risk-on. However, sustaining the gains into 2027 will require stronger domestic growth expectations and an improvement in banking-system liquidity, which could remain constrained as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) tightens monetary policy amid elevated inflation, the global brokerage said. "India has moved from risk-off to risk-on.

daily.title: EPFO New Rule: Is 90% PF Withdrawal Really Allowed?
daily.summary: At its 240th meeting on 19 November 2026, the EPFO's Central Board of Trustees (CBT) cut the mandatory minimum PF balance from 25% to 10% and the waiting period Arithmetically, that lets eligible members withdraw up to 90% of the eligible balance, up from 75%. The board also approved a voluntary Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) for retirees. These changes are not yet in force: the EPF Scheme has to be amended and notified first.

daily.title: Nil Assessment Leads to Quashing of Section 276CC Prosecution: Madras HC
daily.summary: Madras HC quashes Section 276CC prosecution after the Department’s own assessment establishes nil taxable income and undermines alleged wilful tax evasion. The Department alleged that the company was required to file its return under section 139(1) by 30 September 2014 and had failed to do so. Its database showed receipts of ₹88,00,490 on which tax had been deducted at source. It also showed the sale of immovable property for ₹11,59,85,320 during FY 2013–14 . These transactions formed the basis of the allegation that the company had substantial income for the year.

The Central Bureau of Investigation ( CBI ) , along with the Ministry of External Affairs ( MEA ), the Ministry of Home Affairs ( MHA ) and Chhattisgarh Police, on November 27, 2026, secured the deportation of Vikas Agarwal from the UAE to India.

daily.title: Section 153C Assessment Beyond Ten-Year Block Quashed: Delhi HC
daily.summary: Delhi HC quashes Section 153C assessment for AY 2009-10 as the ten-year block calculated from the first satisfaction note extended only to AY 2013-14. Summary: In Consistent Builders Pvt. Ltd. v. ACIT, Central Circle-05, Delhi & Anr. , W.P.(C) No. 6193/2023 , decided on 23 November 2026 , the Delhi High Court quashed a search-related assessment under section 153C for AY 2009–10 . Taking the first satisfaction note dated 25 June 2021 as the reference point, the Court counted backwards from AY 2022–23 and found that the outermost year within the ten-year block was AY 2013–14 .

The High Court noted its own consistent decisions that SAD is refundable, and that the contrary Bombay High Court view had not been followed.

daily.title: India's FY28 fiscal deficit projected to stay unchanged at 4.3% of GDP: Deutsche Bank
daily.summary: Deutsche Bank projects India's FY28 deficit at 4.3% of GDP despite rising pay, subsidies, and oil costs. "The central government will most likely meet its FY27 fiscal deficit target of 4.3% of GDP; however, FY28 consolidation looks considerably more challenging. Considering the various risks, we forecast the FY28 fiscal deficit to remain unchanged at 4.3% of GDP," the report stated. Several cushions support the government's fiscal math in the current fiscal year, including a substantial Reserve Bank of India dividend of ₹2.9 lakh crore, an ₹1 lakh crore Economic Stabilisation Fund provision, potential capital expenditure compression, and higher-than-expected disinvestment receipts.…

daily.title: ITAT Holds Presumptive Taxation Under Section 44AD Does Not Exempt Assessee from Maintaining Books
daily.summary: The ITAT holds cash deposits of Rs. 47.24 lakh as unexplained despite earlier bank withdrawals. The assessee is Rameshbhai Bhikhabhai Bajaniya who filed his return of income for Assessment Year 2017-18 under the presumptive taxation scheme provided under Section 44AD of the Income Tax Act . During the assessment proceedings, the AO noticed cash deposits aggregating to Rs. 47,24,000 in the assessee's ICICI Bank account during the demonetisation period. The AO treated the deposits as unexplained cash credits under Section 68 of the Act.

The directions took effect immediately Non-bank entities seeking to set up, own and operate White Label ATMs (WLAs) must obtain authorisation under the RBI’s Master Direction on Authorisation to operate a Payment System, dated 15 June 2026. breaking.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) eases liquidity-tightening measures, reducing the daily cash reserve ratio (CRR) requirement to 90% as banks face mounting pressure from surging credit demand and slower deposit growth The earlier measure was aimed at absorbing surplus liquidity generated by inflows under the special Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) or FCNR(B) deposit scheme. The decision comes at a time when banks are struggling to keep pace with rising credit demand as deposit mobilisation remains slower. In the fortnight ended November 15, 2026, bank credit grew 19.3% year-on-year, while deposits increased by 16.4%.
